cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I book this coach, identify who can stop the payment, please. Approval and available money are separate checks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Book now or we'll lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've answered the first check. Who can refuse the deposit? A name, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer. She's away, but her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Access isn't authority. Can the deputy release the deposit without her permission? That's the answer I need before I book.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 distinguishes approval from available money, A3 corrects the wrong check and A5 separates login access from delegated power.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 approval and B4 treasurer absence with deputy login form a coherent narrowing investigation.

relationship.evidence: B2 urges booking and B4 offers a practical workaround, which A5 tests rather than discards.

heightening.evidence: B4 login workaround causes A5 question whether deputy can independently release money.

specificity.evidence: A1 coach and deposit checks plus B2 risk of losing booking establish immediate stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final sentence presses for the needed answer without an invented password action.
